summary: Day 3 of 72 (Percentages Mastery: Multipliers & Successive Changes): Lock down base-change formulas (x% increase followed by y% decrease) and linear seating deductions.

urgent_alerts.title: CAT 2026 Registration Close
urgent_alerts.action: Submit CAT 2026 registration, 6 city preferences, and fee payment (₹2,700 Gen) before 5:00 PM cutoff.

urgent_alerts.title: dMAT Status Check (aps-india.de/dmat & g.a.s.t.)
urgent_alerts.action: Check if dMAT registration is closed, exempt, or scheduled for next sitting; if closed, lock Winter 2027/28 branch.

urgent_alerts.title: Anabin H+ Check for MDU Rohtak
urgent_alerts.action: Verify MDU H+ institutional status and B.Tech CSE degree recognition on anabin.kmk.org; save PDF confirmation.

urgent_alerts.title: Run Passau Interactive Guide
urgent_alerts.action: Run Passau interactive application guide for M.Sc. CS/AI to confirm application route (direct portal vs uni-assist; no VPD).

urgent_alerts.title: Email MDU for MOI Letter & Cohort Ranking Doc
urgent_alerts.action: Send email to MDU Rohtak Registrar requesting 100% English Medium-of-Instruction letter and official cohort ranking certificate.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Dedicated Job Outreach Application Batch
blocks.details: Dedicated morning batch: Submit 8–10 tailored applications on Instahyre and LinkedIn Jobs. Target Series A–C tech and European remote roles highlighting Immediate Joiner status.

blocks.title: CAT Day 3: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: Percentages LOD 1 & LOD 2: 25 questions covering Net Price change, A is x% more than B, and income-expenditure splits.. DILR: Linear Arrangements 1 (Single Row, all facing North). Solve 2 sets from Rodha DILR Playlist. Focus on definite vs conditional clues..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 3: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: CL MyZone VARC: Complete RC Module 1 Practice Drill 1 (2 Passages, 8 Questions under 18 mins). Track accuracy. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
